#Análisis de diseño experimmental

#Base de datos

## Identificar factores 

1. Factor 1: genotipo
2. Factor 2: riego

## Identificar el modelo

Factorial en DBCA

$$y= \mu+ bloque + G + I+ G*I + \xi$$

# Activar los paquetes 

# Project Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

source('https://inkaverse.com/setup.r')
```

# Data import

```{r}
gs <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15r7ZwcZZHbEgltlF6gSFvCTFA-CFzVBWwg3mFlRyKPs/edit?gid=172957346#gid=172957346" %>% 
  as_sheets_id()

fb <- gs %>% 
  range_read(ss = .,sheet = "fb") %>% 
  mutate(across(c(1:4), ~ as.factor(.))) 

fb %>% str()
```


# Análisis de varianza 

```{r}
# aov() ó lm()

md <- aov(formula = lfa ~ block + irrigation + genotype + irrigation * genotype, fb)

anova (md)
```

# Comparación de medias 

```{r}
mc <- emmeans(md, ~ irrigation * genotype)

# letras de significancia 

tab <- cld (mc, 
            adjust = "tukey", 
            Letters = letters,
            decreasing = T)

tab
```


# Representación gráfica

```{r}
pl <- plot_smr(data = tab,
               x = "genotype",
               y = "emmean",
               group = "irrigation",
               error = "SE",
               sig = ".group",
               ylab = "Área foliar (cm2)"
               )

pl
```
